card.name: Linking words before birth control methods
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation ("such as", "also called the", "and", a comma) just before a birth control method is named, in contraception and family planning text.

modes.label: "such as" before methods
modes.description: The word "as" in "such as" leading into a list of barrier or backup contraceptives.

modes.label: "also called the" naming a method
modes.description: The word "the" after "also called" before a natural family planning method name.
modes.example: Rhythm method: Couples who practice the rhythm method, also called<< the>> calendar method, decide when to abstain

modes.label: Joining or listing methods
modes.description: An "and" or comma after a method, before the next item in a list.
